errors: No arithmetic errors detectable. The centring elements (e = 0.51327 m, 344°1'56") differ slightly from those implied by the Stp. offsets (0.51304 m, ~343°56'). This probably means the offsets are rounded or the elements were determined independently on site, not a slip.

Reciprocal oriented directions agree only to 0.4–2.6" (e.g. Lüneburg–Lauenburg 2.6"), and Lüneburg/Hohen Bünstorf (p.286) differ by ~11.7". This reflects observational and orientation discrepancies (cf. the signed residuals), not computational errors.
Bretze line '129.8.24,789' has no target name.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine geodetic data reduction from Gauss's well-documented Hanoverian survey work. These are centring corrections and oriented direction lists with no new mathematical content.
